# pve_notification_endpoint_smtp (Resource)

Manages a SMTP notification endpoint (`POST/PUT/DELETE /cluster/notifications/endpoints/smtp/{name}`). Every mutation is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_notification_endpoint_smtp" "relay" {
  name         = "mailrelay"
  server       = "smtp.example.com"
  from_address = "pve@example.com"
  username     = "mailer"
  password     = "your-smtp-password"
  port         = 587
  mode         = "starttls"
  mailto       = ["ops@example.com"]
  comment      = "SMTP relay for cluster notifications"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) `From` address for the mail.
- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint (PVE `pve-configid` format). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `server` (String) The address of the SMTP server.

### Optional

- `author` (String) Author of the mail. Defaults to `Proxmox VE` on the server. Removed when unset on update.
- `comment` (String) Comment. Removed when unset on update.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target. PVE defaults to `false`.
- `mailto` (List of String) List of email recipients (PVE `email-or-username` format). Removed when unset on update.
- `mailto_user` (List of String) List of PVE users (e.g. `root@pam`) whose configured mail addresses receive the notification. Removed when unset on update.
- `mode` (String) Determine which encryption method shall be used for the connection. Must be one of: `insecure`, `starttls`, `tls`. Defaults to `tls` on the server. Removed when unset on update.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for SMTP authentication. Write-only: PVE never returns it, so drift cannot be detected. Removed when unset on update.
- `port` (Number) The port to be used. Defaults to 465 for TLS based connections, 587 for STARTTLS based connections and port 25 for insecure plain-text connections. Removed when unset on update.
- `username` (String) Username for SMTP authentication. Removed when unset on update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing smtp endpoint by its name:
terraform import pve_notification_endpoint_smtp.relay mailrelay
```
